summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Vale Overseas Limited applied to NAFMII to register a 2026-2028 RMB-denominated debt instrument program of up to RMB 10 billion (a Panda Bond program), with the parent fully and unconditionally guaranteeing any notes issued. The registration is subject to NAFMII approval and is not an issuance; no bonds have been sold and no terms, pricing, or timing are set. The US-equivalent framing is a shelf registration for a subsidiary's unsecured notes. Watch for NAFMII approval and any subsequent issuance announcement.
